# Can either external dataset test methylation-dependent JUN–FOXP1 maintenance?

**Local closeout · 21 November 2026.** Neither candidate measures whether methylation modulates binding by the JUN–FOXP1 pair or whether the pair maintains accessibility in recovering colon. Each supports a narrower comparison. Yin provides sequence coverage for a short CpG–AP1 context with each isolated factor. The independent colon array provides complete, strand-resolved measurements at eight native flanking CpGs in five amplicons. [Frozen scope](DESIGN.md) · [Stage 3 results](../stage3/RESULTS.md) · [Execution receipt](../../../../analysis/research/runs/ng26_jf_external_qualification_v1/receipt.json)

## Yin · Starting libraries recovered, exact locus too sparse

Yin et al. performed conventional and CpG-methylated HT-SELEX using randomized 40-base ligands. ENA identifies four successive selected cycles per condition for full-length human JUN and the human FOXP1 extended DNA-binding domain. The authors deposited their initial libraries in a separate ENA project. Each of the four selected barcode strings has one exact zero-cycle match. All four input XML records label the protocol HT-SELEX. They establish starting sequence composition for the matched barcode; they do not independently certify the methylation state of an individual starting molecule. The paper describes CpG methylation before each selection in the methylated series. [Yin et al., Fig. 1A and HT-/methyl-SELEX methods](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8009048/) · [Selected libraries, PRJEB9797](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/view/PRJEB9797) · [Starting libraries, PRJEB20112](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/view/PRJEB20112)

| Isolated factor and selected protocol | Exact ligand barcode | Public zero-cycle run | Selected runs, cycles 1 through 4 | Exact 12-bp reads at cycles 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| JUN, conventional | TCAGTG40NGAT | [ERR1896299](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/view/ERR1896299) | ERR1004354 / 4356 / 4358 / 4360 | 1 / 1 / 2 / 0 / 2 |
| JUN, methylated | TTTGCC40NTGA | [ERR1895975](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/view/ERR1895975) | ERR1004355 / 4357 / 4359 / 4361 | 2 / 0 / 1 / 1 / 1 |
| FOXP1, conventional | TACCCT40NTTA | [ERR1896106](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/view/ERR1896106) | ERR1003378 / 3380 / 3382 / 3384 | 0 / 2 / 1 / 0 / 0 |
| FOXP1, methylated | TTATGA40NCAG | [ERR1895835](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/view/ERR1895835) | ERR1003379 / 3381 / 3383 / 3385 | 2 / 2 / 0 / 0 / 1 |

Of 4,345,270 released reads, 4,291,309 were unambiguous 40-base inserts. Presence in either orientation counted once per read. At the only CpG-bearing scored motif (mm10 chr13:52,892,163–52,892,175, zero-based half-open), the exact sequence `CGTGACTCAGTG` occurred **0–2 times per library**. Adding two native bases at each end gave `ACCGTGACTCAGTGTG`. That 16-base sequence occurred once in the FOXP1 methyl-series starting library and zero times in all 16 selected libraries. The shorter `CGTGACTCA`, which retains the CpG immediately upstream of the AP1 heptamer, occurred **25–116 times per library** across all 20 libraries. The full native amplicon exceeds the 40-base insert length. [All 20 accessions, protocols, FASTQ URLs and checksums](../../../../analysis/research/runs/ng26_jf_external_qualification_v1/yin_libraries.tsv) · [Exact sequence, orientation, denominators and distinct insert counts](../../../../analysis/research/runs/ng26_jf_external_qualification_v1/yin_context_coverage.tsv)

**Decision.** The exact scored motif and its native flanks have insufficient support for a stable sequence-specific comparison. The 9-base context qualifies for a separately designed comparison of relative selection by each isolated construct in the conventional and methylated libraries. Such a comparison would use each barcode’s starting distribution and account for other CpGs and sequence context in the 40-base ligands. Successive cycles reuse a selection pool, and a selected sequence count does not measure affinity directly. No preference direction was estimated. This candidate supplies no paired JUN–FOXP1 condition, colonic chromatin, occupancy measurement or recovery timeline.

## GSE283386 · Eight exact flanking dyads in five fragments

The independent study used colonic epithelial DNA from 12 male C57BL/6J mice. Its four groups were saline + water, saline + DSS, 5-AZA + water and 5-AZA + DSS, with three mice each. Five days of 2.5% DSS were followed by collection 14 days after withdrawal. The first 5-AZA or saline dose came two days before DSS began, followed by doses on days 5 and 10 after withdrawal. Drug exposure therefore spans induction and recovery. The deposited analysis applied SeSAMe detection filtering (P < 0.05), background subtraction, strain-interference and dye-bias correction. Each array column maps to a GEO sample via both raw IDAT channel filenames. [GSE283386 sample records and study design](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE283386) · [Primary paper, Fig. 4a and array methods](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12873232/) · [12-sample crosswalk](../../../../analysis/research/runs/ng26_jf_external_qualification_v1/array_specimens.tsv)

|---|---|---|---:|:---:|
| chr3:101213315–101213327 | cg40106775_BC21 | Right | 101213355 | + |
| chr4:133886318–133886330 | cg41514640_BC21 | Left | 133886204 | − |
| chr4:133886318–133886330 | cg41514641_TC21 | Right | 133886345 | − |
| chr4:133886318–133886330 | cg41514643_BC21 | Right | 133886407 | + |
| chr6:30307892–30307904 | cg43259781_BC21 | Left | 30307884 | − |
| chr6:57769478–57769490 | cg43474386_BC11 | Left | 57769313 | + |

| chr13:52892163–52892175 | cg31603876_BC21 | Right | 52892372 | − |

For GPL30650 a CpG target is the two-base half-open mm10 interval `[s, s+2)`. Each of the eight intervals is exactly CG in the frozen reference. The Stage 2 site anchor is the plus-strand C at `s`. For a minus-strand probe, the assayed C sits opposite the reference G at `s+1`. We checked all eight strand labels using the annotation authors’ versioned mm10 coordinate table and its corresponding probe-ID order. The reported mapping flags also agree. Both native base positions were covered in all six P4 lines and all six tissue-vehicle mice at every dyad. A later same-strand comparison can therefore use the original native value at the interrogated position. Stage 2 history summaries used the plus-C convention throughout. [GPL30650 manifest](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GPL30650) · [Manifest coordinate definitions](https://zwdzwd.github.io/InfiniumAnnotation/manifestV2.html) · [Versioned MM285 annotation](https://github.com/zhou-lab/InfiniumAnnotation/tree/v8.6/MM285) · [Dyad and strand crosswalk](../../../../analysis/research/runs/ng26_jf_external_qualification_v1/array_dyads.tsv) · [Native coverage by specimen and strand](../../../../analysis/research/runs/ng26_jf_external_qualification_v1/native_dyad_coverage.tsv)

All eight probes had finite beta values within [0, 1] in **3/3 mice in every arm** (96/96 probe–mouse measurements). Three probes were in left flanks and five in right flanks. Zero target a scored motif. The chr13 probe is in the amplicon containing the sole scored-motif CpG, but its plus-C is **209 bp downstream** of that CpG. These are eight distinct native dyads. [Per-probe arm counts](../../../../analysis/research/runs/ng26_jf_external_qualification_v1/array_arm_counts.tsv) · [96 individual availability records](../../../../analysis/research/runs/ng26_jf_external_qualification_v1/array_availability.tsv)

**Decision.** The array qualifies for a day-14 regional comparison at these eight exact dyads, including a possible saline-treated DSS-versus-water history contrast and a separate comparison of responses to the combined pre- and post-DSS drug schedule. Five selected amplicons cannot represent the full panel. The array measures neither the sole scored-motif CpG nor occupancy of JUN or FOXP1. Its drug schedule cannot separate maintenance after recovery from effects on initial injury. No external beta difference was computed.

## Closeout

The original paired biochemical increment showed little association with the day-102 ordering of accessibility (partial rank ρ = −0.015 across 63 loci). A P4 day-50 regional pattern and a negative whole-tissue binding–methylation association had different model and denominator sensitivities. The external data support two narrower questions about isolated-factor selection in a shortened context and early regional methylation at eight flanking dyads. Neither resolves methylation-dependent co-binding or the maintenance mechanism in colon.
